venue: fictional Magistrates' Court with possible Crown Court bail route
scenario: Leila Okoro is accused after entry to a locked marine-parts warehouse and recovery of boxed components from a van she sometimes used. She disputes entry, knowledge and exclusive vehicle use. At first appearance the prosecution alleges failure-to-surrender, further-offending and witness-contact risks. A supported address, employment pattern, treatment needs and a proposed surety are offered. Bail is granted on recorded conditions; a later work-hours variation and an alleged indirect-contact breach are separately litigated.
